description: A D_PDU too large for the configured transmission length goes in exactly the blocks it needs, counting the modem's end-of-message marker, and its EOT covers them.
note: Conn 1 binds SAP 5 for non-ARQ and gets S_BIND_ACCEPTED (A-0041, A-0047); at 0 it sends S_UNIDATA_REQUEST (priority 0 to SAP 5 at 0.0.1.3, TTL 0 so TTD 1296000000 ms, no retransmissions, no confirmation): no SIS output (A-0095), dts.ttd starts (C-1050), and csma.lbt_wait starts with lbt_wait_dcd_ms 30000 (K-0077). The DATA C_PDU holds the DATA S_PDU SAP 5 to SAP 5 with its TTD; each type 7 has address size 3 and C_PDU ID 0, and its EOT and reception window are the half seconds from the start of its block to the end of the burst, rounded up (C-0104, C-0350, C-1043). Fixture (test data): preamble 600, flush 150, WN 2 Long blocks of 4800 ms, eom_bytes 4, so n blocks carry n x block_bytes - 4 bytes and a burst of m bytes takes ceil((m + 4) / block_bytes) blocks (corpus-format.md 5; interp C-1290). dts.max_transmission_ms 5550 allows one block (600 + 4800 + 150). 0.0.1.3 is of unknown edition, so there is no PADDING fill (C-1154), and csma.num_cont_slots 1 makes the contention wait 0 (K-0080). Here the blocks are 40 bytes. U_PDU "0123456789": the C_PDU is 16 bytes in one segment (dts.max_segment_size 1023), a 40-byte D_PDU. The one block within the limit carries 40 - 4 = 36 bytes, so the D_PDU does not fit; it is not blocked (C-0551, C-0878): the transmission is made the whole blocks it needs, ceil((40 + 4) / 40) = 2 (C-1042, C-1290), 600 + 9600 + 150 = 10350 ms. Its EOT counts from block 0 to the end, flush and marker included: ceil(9750 / 500) = 20 (C-0104, C-0891, D-0005, D-0017), and so does its reception window, 20, since nothing is left for later (C-0350). It empties the queue, so dts.ttd is cancelled first (C-1050).
